newsitem.title: INDIA: India to sell 30 bln rupees of 8-yr securities.
newsitem.headline: India to sell 30 bln rupees of 8-yr securities.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) will auction 30 billion rupees of eight-year securities on August 11, the government said on Monday.

"The government of India has announced the sale of dated securities of eight-year tenure in the form of stock to the public by auction for the aggregate amount of 30 billion rupees," it said in a statement.
The government stock is eligible for the ready-forward facility, it said.
